import json,sys,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())['result']; z=np.load(sys.argv[2]); sites=z['sites']; D=z['D']; N=4
literal=np.array([(x,y,z) for x in range(N) for y in range(N) for z in range(N)])
assert np.array_equal(sites,literal)
expected=np.zeros_like(D); lookup={tuple(x):i for i,x in enumerate(sites)}
for i,x in enumerate(sites):
 for mu in range(3):
  y=x.copy(); y[mu]=(y[mu]+1)%N; expected[i,3*i+mu]=1; expected[lookup[tuple(y)],3*i+mu]=-1
assert np.array_equal(D,expected)
for row in r['rows']:
 k=np.zeros(192,dtype=np.int64)
 for e,v in row['character']: k[e]=v
 assert np.all(D@k==0)
assert all(row['winding']!=[0,0,0] for row in r['rows'])
k=np.zeros(192,dtype=np.int64)
for e,v in r['known_contractible_plaquette_positive_control']['character']: k[e]=v
assert np.all(D@k==0)
print(json.dumps(dict(actual_site_order_exact=True,actual_D_orientation_exact=True,all96_modes_actual_Gauss_closed=True,positive_contractible_control_actual_Gauss_closed=True,scope='Binding of previous exact character classification to authoritative N4 geometry, not a new source execution or infrared inference.')))
